en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large late‑19th / early‑20th‑century stone building on a street corner. The structure has steep tiled roofs, dormers, a small clock turret with a weather vane, and an oriel-style bay with large windows decorated with geometric patterns. The street is lined with young trees, fencing, and lampposts; a few pedestrians are visible. On the right side there is a street sign mounted on a pole.
